searchText: Guys, can I please ask you for explanation of one concept? Specifically, I am trying to determine when whistleblowing message that led to slashing of validator 14415 happened at earliest. So taking this example, validator 14415 was slashed at slot 457006. Given this screenshot, my understanding is that he was voting at slot 456995--which is at epoch 14278--but was late and his vote counted at epoch 14281. Later on, he voted at slot 457005--which is at epoch 14280--**correctly** to epoch 14281 but since he voted for two conflicting blocks in the same epoch, he got slashed. So the whistleblowing message **couldn't happen before slot 457005** because only at this slot slashable offence happened. Is this correct? Pleaseee help me with that. no, 456995 is **not** in epoch 14278, it is in epoch 14281. The thing is that this validator was voting for the block https://beaconcha.in/block/456932, which actually is in epoch 14279, which would have been a correct vote, but he sent that vote late in epoch 14281. How do you know that he was voting for block 456932? Given what you are saying, this means that he made a late vote, but while this is bad overall, it is not a slashable offence, right? Slashable offence happened only when he voted for two different blocks for the same epoch, correct? Thank you for help! yes, attestation 1 came late, but it was earlier than attestation 2, attestation 2 is the slashable offense as it's a second vote for the same target (and is a different attestation). excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: no, 456995 is **not** in epoch 14278, it is in epoch 14281. The thing is that this validator was voting for the block https://beaconcha.in/block/456932, which actually is in epoch 14279, which would have been a correct vote, but he sent that vote late in epoch 14281.

excerpts.author: lem888
excerpts.content: How do you know that he was voting for block 456932? Given what you are saying, this means that he made a late vote, but while this is bad overall, it is not a slashable offence, right? Slashable offence happened only when he voted for two different blocks for the same epoch, correct? Thank you for help!

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: yes, attestation 1 came late, but it was earlier than attestation 2, attestation 2 is the slashable offense as it's a second vote for the same target (and is a different attestation). I know he was voting for that block because that's the hash of his vote. Going to sleep here
